rusty_key.name: rusty key
rusty_key.description: A small iron key almost entirely consumed by rust. Whatever lock it belongs to, it has not been turned in a very long time.

old_book.name: old book
old_book.description: A thick volume bound in cracked leather, its pages yellowed and brittle. The title has been deliberately scratched off the cover.

magnifying_glass.name: magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: A brass-handled magnifying glass with a faintly warped lens. Objects viewed through it look slightly wrong.

quill_pen.name: quill pen
quill_pen.description: A long black feather cut into a writing quill, its nib stained permanently dark with old ink.

secret_letter.name: secret letter
secret_letter.description: A folded letter sealed with red wax, hidden behind the old book. The wax seal bears an insignia that has been partially melted away.

wooden_chest.name: wooden chest
wooden_chest.description: A sturdy wooden chest bound in iron strips, its surface carved with small repeating symbols that may or may not be decorative.

letter_opener.name: letter opener
letter_opener.description: A slim blade made for correspondence, too delicate to be called a knife but sharp enough to be dangerous in the wrong hands.

tattered_cloak.name: tattered cloak
tattered_cloak.description: A heavy wool cloak, deep grey, with the hem torn away unevenly. Still serviceable as protection against the cold and incidental contact.

health_potion.name: health potion
health_potion.description: A small glass vial stoppered with wax, containing a viscous liquid the colour of old blood. It smells faintly of copper and something floral.

knife.name: knife
knife.description: A plain kitchen knife, unadorned and practical. The edge has been kept sharp out of habit by whoever last owned it.

silver_coin.name: silver coin
silver_coin.description: A tarnished coin of unfamiliar denomination. The face stamped on it does not match any known monarch, and the date on the reverse is impossible.

loaf_of_stale_bread.name: loaf of stale bread
loaf_of_stale_bread.description: A dense loaf gone hard as stone. It has not yet grown mould, which is the only remarkable thing about it.

battered_tin_box.name: battered tin box
battered_tin_box.description: A small tin box dented on every face, its lid bent but functional. It rattles faintly when moved.

kitchen_knife.name: kitchen knife
kitchen_knife.description: A heavier blade than the small knife nearby, clearly made for the butcher's block. Its weight makes it an effective weapon.

ancient_tome.name: ancient tome
ancient_tome.description: An enormous book with a cover made from something that is not quite leather. The text inside shifts language between pages, as if written by many hands over many centuries.

candle.name: candle
candle.description: A thick tallow candle, half-burned. It was recently extinguished — the wick is still warm.

hidden_note.name: hidden note
hidden_note.description: A small note tucked inside the ancient tome, written in a cramped hand. The ink is fresh enough to smudge.

fire_poker.name: fire poker
fire_poker.description: A long iron rod with a hook at one end, designed for managing fires. Heavy enough to make a person reconsider their choices.

iron_helmet.name: iron helmet
iron_helmet.description: A simple iron helmet with no visor, dented along one side in a way that suggests it was not enough.

ornate_box.name: ornate box
ornate_box.description: A small box lacquered in black and inlaid with a pattern of pale bones. It is very beautiful and very unsettling.

golden_goblet.name: golden goblet
golden_goblet.description: A heavy goblet of solid gold, engraved around the rim with a phrase in a language that predates the mansion itself. It is always slightly warm to the touch.

invitation.name: invitation
invitation.description: A formal dinner invitation on heavy card, addressed to a name that has been smudged. The date listed is eighty years ago. The RSVPs have all been returned — declined.

dusty_lockbox.name: dusty lockbox
dusty_lockbox.description: A metal box sealed with a combination lock, the numbers worn smooth with use. Someone opened this regularly, once.

glass_jar.name: glass jar
glass_jar.description: A wide-mouthed glass jar, sealed with a rubber ring and a wire clasp. It is empty, but the inside smells strongly of something that once lived in it.

poison_vial.name: poison vial
poison_vial.description: A thin glass vial containing a clear liquid. The skull etched into the stopper is either a warning or a boast.

strange_amulet.name: strange amulet
strange_amulet.description: A disc of dark metal on a chain, covered in symbols that seem to rearrange themselves when you look away. It is cold regardless of how long it is held.

ritual_dagger.name: ritual dagger
ritual_dagger.description: A narrow blade with a groove running its full length, its handle wrapped in cord that has been dyed black. It was made to pierce something specific.

magic_staff.name: magic staff
magic_staff.description: A length of wood that has no grain and casts no shadow. It hums at a frequency just below hearing when held.

leather_boots.name: leather boots
leather_boots.description: Tall leather boots, well-made and barely worn. They fit anyone who puts them on, regardless of foot size, which is convenient and disturbing.

herbs.name: herbs
herbs.description: A bundle of dried plants tied with rough string. They smell strongly medicinal, with an undertone of something sharper and more dangerous.

silver_bullet.name: silver bullet
silver_bullet.description: A single bullet cast in pure silver, sitting at the centre of the herb bundle as if left there deliberately. It fits no gun currently in the mansion.

broken_chain.name: broken chain
broken_chain.description: A length of heavy iron chain with one link sheared clean through. The force required to break it this way was considerable.

locket.name: locket
locket.description: A small oval locket on a fine chain, its clasp rusted shut. Something shifts inside it when it is tilted — too light to be a photograph, too heavy to be nothing.

rotting_satchel.name: rotting satchel
rotting_satchel.description: A leather satchel in advanced decay, its strap giving way and its buckles green with oxidation. It was expensive once.

rusty_sword.name: rusty sword
rusty_sword.description: A broadsword corroded to a deep orange-brown along most of its length, but the edge has been kept free of rust with deliberate care. Someone maintained this weapon long after hope had gone.

chain_gloves.name: chain gloves
chain_gloves.description: Gloves of fine chain mail, each link no larger than a thumbnail. They are supple enough to wear and heavy enough to matter.

iron_key.name: iron key
iron_key.description: A heavy iron key etched with a skull, warm to the touch as if recently held. It opens something that was meant to stay closed.

silver_vial.name: silver vial
silver_vial.description: A slender vial of silver liquid on a fine chain. The contents neutralise any poison. It smells faintly of something ancient and cold.

enchanted_crossbow.name: enchanted crossbow
enchanted_crossbow.description: A compact crossbow wound with copper wire that hums faintly. Aldous claims it never needs reloading. This is almost certainly an exaggeration.

iron_sword.name: iron sword
iron_sword.description: A serviceable iron blade, well-balanced and recently sharpened. Nothing special — but reliable, which counts for something in a haunted mansion.

silver_dagger.name: silver dagger
silver_dagger.description: A short blade cast entirely in silver, its edge holding an unnatural keenness. Certain creatures find its touch particularly unpleasant.

magic_wand.name: magic wand
magic_wand.description: A slender rod of pale wood that grows warm in the hand. It channels something — what exactly, Aldous declines to specify.

leather_armour.name: leather armour
leather_armour.description: A fitted cuirass of boiled leather, lacquered dark. It will not stop a determined blade, but it will slow one down considerably.

blood_pact.name: blood pact
blood_pact.description: A sheaf of parchment bound with black ribbon, signed in a cramped hand and sealed with something darker than ink. The words crawl across the page when read directly, as though they are still being written. Lord Harwick Vane's name appears at the bottom, beneath a signature that is not human.

unmaking_flame.name: unmaking flame
unmaking_flame.description: A sealed glass vial containing a tongue of cold blue fire that does not consume the glass. It smells of ozone and old grief. Whatever burns in this flame is unmade entirely — not destroyed, but erased, as though it never was.

sturdy_boots.name: sturdy boots
sturdy_boots.description: Heavy-soled boots with reinforced toe caps and ankle guards. They add a deliberate weight to each step, which feels appropriate in a place like this.
